# FG-CI-0022

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 413 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_upload_past_the_project_quota_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: プロジェクトの CI の成果物が保存の上限に達しました。成果物は保存されず、ジョブは失敗にしました。
- en: The project's CI artifacts reached their storage quota. The artifact was not stored and the job was failed.
- id: Artefak CI proyek mencapai kuota penyimpanan. Artefak tidak disimpan dan tugas digagalkan.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C6 review: the stored artifacts of one project (every job, until they expire after 30 days) may hold at most `ci.artifact_quota_bytes` (default 5 GiB). An upload that would pass it is refused (413), checked before the bytes are read and again, atomically, when the artifact is recorded.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `project_id`, `stored_bytes`, `quota_bytes`. Read: SELECT count(*), sum(size_bytes), min(expires_at) FROM forge.ci_artifacts WHERE project_id = <id>;

## 対処 (fix)

Declare fewer or smaller artifact paths, or wait for older artifacts to expire; the operator may raise `ci.artifact_quota_bytes` (runbook ci-runner, Artifacts) and restart forge serve.
